segments.title: Crows decide 2x FASTER than you
segments.say: Crows can make a decision about twice as fast as you can. In about a quarter of a second.

segments.title: The test: which way do dots move?
segments.sub: Peck **left or right** on a touchscreen
segments.say: Scientists in Germany showed two crows a screen of moving dots. Left or right? Peck the answer.

segments.title: 235 milliseconds
segments.say: They answered in about two hundred thirty five milliseconds, and got almost every easy round right.

segments.title: Humans take about twice as long
segments.sub: On **similar** tests, not the same one
segments.say: In earlier studies on similar tasks, humans and monkeys took about twice as long.

segments.title: Their brain called it early
segments.sub: Neurons predicted the choice **before the peck**
segments.say: Their brain cells even showed the choice before the beak moved.

segments.sub: to the friend who takes 20 minutes to order
segments.say: Send this to the friend who takes twenty minutes to order.
